entries.basis: Three original reviews of Harry Styles’ fourth studio album, Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally.: Shaad D’Souza (Pitchfork, March 9, 2026), Rhian Daly (NME, March 4), and Alexis Petridis (The Guardian, March 4). These concern the album rather than the Aperture single, Netflix concert or Harry’s House. Distinct publications offer differing assessments. Dates identify original articles, not the March 6 album release or later edits. Sentiment estimates describe the cited passages. NME was verified in a rendered browser despite plain-fetch HTTP 403. No reader-score placeholder was used.
